D5/S3/Quantum/Schatten/CompoundMatrices..name: cauchyBinet
D5/S3/Quantum/Schatten/CompoundMatrices..signature: lemma cauchyBinet {m : ℕ} {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [LinearOrder n] {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (A : Matrix (Fin m) n R) (B : Matrix n (Fin m) R) : (A * B).det = ∑ S : {S : Finset n // S.card = m}, (A.submatrix id (S.1.orderEmbOfFin S.2)).det * (B.submatrix (S.1.orderEmbOfFin S.2) id).det
